invariants.expression: alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.left || alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.center || alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.right

Alignment constants like left, center, and right are typically represented by non-negative integers.

meta.value: Alignment values are usually non-negative constants
